content:
mia: Quick sync 1 — launching paid search + retarget for the "Serving LLMs" webinar. Need creatives, pacing, tracking, and lead routing. Target launch: Wed 2026-05-06. :rocket:
sam: Targets: 1k signups in 10 days, CPL goal $90. Budget split this initial week: $14k search / $6k retarget. Keep daily pacing rules. :money_with_wings:
jen: Creative plan: 3 headlines + 2 descriptions per ad group. Test value props: "SLA-backed inference" vs "Cut inference spend 30%". Rotate creative every 48h, but keep a control creative pinned. :art:
oliver: Bids: start manual CPC with enhanced conversions on. Max CPC $10 for top intent keywords. Retarget set as CPM with 14d lookback. Frequency cap for display retarget = 5 impressions/day. :white_check_mark:
mia: Tracking: push lead webhook to HubSpot and mirror to Segment. If webhook fails, send fallback email to ops@redwood.com and flag in #ads-ops. Also preserve UTMs.
ads-bot: Staging QA scheduled 2026-05-05T15:00Z. Tests: 1) tracking pixels fire on submit, 2) form posts to HubSpot, 3) UTMs intact in HubSpot, 4) landing variant A/B renders. Report to #ads-qa.

ads-bot: Pixel snippet for QA:
```html
<script>window.analytics && window.analytics.track && window.analytics.track('Lead Submitted', { email: '{{email}}', campaign: '{{utm_campaign}}', creative: '{{ad_id}}' });</script>
```

jen: UTM scheme we agreed: utm_source=google; utm_medium=cpc; utm_campaign=webinar_serving_inference_may26; utm_content={{ad_id}}; utm_term={{keyword}}. Try to keep full URL <= 120 chars.
sam: Pacing rules: ramp 40% budget day1, 70% day3, full run day5. Monitoring: alert & pause ad group if 3-day CPL > $150 OR CTR < 0.5%. Auto-pause threshold trips 2x => escalation.
oliver: Retarget seeds: 30-day site visitors + 14-day docs viewers. Exclude customers; treat trialers as high-intent (separate audience, +25% bid). List sizes and expected reach added to the sheet.
mia: Landing variants: short-form sign-up (one-step) vs long-form (benefits + CTA). A/B test for conversion and lead quality. Funnel conversion metric = registration -> attended webinar (tracked by post-event webhook).
sam: Quick ask: can growth run an auction snapshot tomorrow for top 25 keywords so we have live CPC estimates? I'll use that to set initial bids.
jen: I'll upload creatives by Tue EOD and tag each creative with creative_id. Will prepare 5 headline alternates for rapid refresh. Creative refresh cadence: swap one headline every 48h first week, then remove lowest performer after 7 days.
oliver: I'll configure audiences & bids and add the frequency/pacing settings in the campaign sheet. Also adding the HubSpot form mapping.
mia: Owners: jen -> creatives, oliver -> audience + bids, sam -> budgets + alerts, ads-bot -> QA. Everyone add checklist to the launch playbook doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/launch-playbooks/webinar-serving-llms by EOD Tue. Pre-launch call Wed 9am PT. :calendar:
